summary: Iteration 6 verified: (1) 'dispute' fully removed from /new page control, list badges, filter panel, edit dialog, and detail page. (2) Status filter present (data-testid=filter-status) and persists in localStorage 'eurasia_receival_filters'. (3) Admin invoice number end-to-end works: edit dialog -> save -> row badge (invoice-number-<id>) -> reload persistence -> search matches -> detail page shows 'Invoice number' field + 'Invoice #' badge near title + change history entry. Staff cannot set invoiceNumber (403 backend, no edit UI in frontend). Staff PUT with palletCount/observation/items still 200. Backend 5/5 pytest passing; frontend flows verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: ReceivalListPage.js is ~567 lines and mixes filter/search/edit-dialog/list rendering; consider splitting the Edit dialog and Filter panel into their own components for maintainability (still under 700-line threshold, but growing).
Backend startup admin-password re-hash logic (server.py L582-583) only re-hashes when the new password does not verify; consider idempotent seed w/ explicit env-toggle log entry.

PUT /api/receivals/{id} for staff sends 403 with detail listing forbidden fields. Frontend does not surface that reason to the user — currently moot because staff has no invoice UI, but any future staff-facing PUT should show the field-specific error.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed receival (id 57540c6c-...) to set/clear invoiceNumber INV-TEST-123 through the UI. Invoice number reset to null via API after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_invoice.py — reuse admin_token/staff_token fixtures. Login UI: submit button text is 'Sign in' (Admin tab) and 'Enter' (Staff PIN tab). Detail page is opened via 'View' button (route /receival/<id>, singular). Row edit buttons carry data-testid=edit-<uuid>; save button data-testid=edit-save; invoice input data-testid=edit-invoice-number; row badge data-testid=invoice-number-<uuid>. Filter panel is toggled by data-testid=toggle-filters-btn and includes data-testid=filter-status.
